sentence: This project supplies safe pork for oral food challenges so a trial can find markers of allergic reactions in alpha-gal syndrome.
This project uses statistical methods to work out how to measure results from ELIspot assays and whether those results can predict longer term clinical benefit.
This project builds a low-cost test that detects the bacterium Neisseria gonorrhoeae and signs of antimicrobial resistance, and tries it out in a low-resource setting.
This project studies how an anti-leukemia drug injures the liver and looks for ways to prevent that injury.
This project tries to find which genes raise the risk of atrial fibrillation and how they change the way heart muscle cells work.
This project uses stem cell-derived islet organoids and human islets to study how genes linked to type 2 diabetes work together in islet cells.
This project uses textual notes written by emergency department clinicians and emergency medical services staff to build machine learned models that find overdose information.
This project studies the genes and proteins that let Coccidioides grow as spherules in a mammalian host and avoid the immune response.
This project uses mass spectrometry to measure protein changes in tumor tissues and preclinical models, to find cancer protein targets linked to genomic alterations.
This project tries to find out what role the protein Tbc1d2b plays in the formation of blood vessels after ischemic injury.
This project adapts a pulmonary rehabilitation program with exercise, education and behavior change for people with lung disease after tuberculosis treatment.
This project tries to find out whether and how learning rules at synapses between the cortex and basal ganglia help birdsong learning.
This project supports cancer prevention and control research that turns findings from pre-clinical and observational studies into randomized studies.
This project tries to find out how general anesthesia harms mitochondria in developing neurons and tests small molecules that may protect them.
This project studies how inflammation around the coronary arteries, seen on cardiac computed tomography, relates to plaque development in people with HIV.
This project builds small molecules that switch on protective signaling in the unfolded protein response, which helps cells cope with endoplasmic reticulum stress.
This project builds spectroscopic instruments, chip design, robotic manipulation and targeted tracers to help find lung tumors during biopsy and surgery.
This project builds statistical tools that use data from many sources to recommend the treatment option for each individual patient.
This project builds image analysis methods that measure brain pathology in autism spectrum disorder and predict how people respond to therapy.
This project develops technology that uses higher resolution imaging at 7T to better assess meniscal root tears, a root cause of osteoarthritis in the knee.
